sentences.text: Yes. At the time of reset of interest rates for EMI based floating rate personal loans, the lender shall provide borrowers the option to switch over to a fixed rate, and this rule applies to this case as of 2025-09-15.

The bank’s own policy says the bank may, at its option, offer a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset, but the applicable RBI instruction is mandatory and therefore controls for this case.
